task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Write a Qiskit program that prepares the 4-qubit W state exactly (using controlled rotations) and verifies it by printing the statevector amplitudes of the basis states with a single 1. Your answer must be the complete working code only, runnable from top to bottom.
